1.consolidated_definition: alim. Torta. Especie de torta pequeña y fina, hecha de harina, huevo, mantequilla y sal que se fríe con mantequilla. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Su menú de brunch ofrece desde huevos florentinos con espinaca y salsa bechamel y pancakes con mantequilla de arándano, hasta wrap de churrasco y ensalada de pollo, entre otros platillos (Primera Hora, 10-10-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Food item. A small and fine type of cake made from flour, egg, butter, and salt that is fried with butter. Anglicism in its raw form, commonly used.

Its brunch menu offers a variety of dishes, including Florentine eggs with spinach and bechamel sauce, pancakes with blueberry butter, churrasco wraps, and chicken salad, among others (Primera Hora, 10-10-07)
